item.laowu.agent_suit.tooltip.summary: Combat: High-damage melee with guaranteed rear criticals. Smart cats flank. When targeted with nearby non-support friendly cats, retreats under smoke. Work: While seated on a cushion, reveals hostile creatures with red outlines. Intelligence increases the watch radius, up to 128 blocks.
item.laowu.diving_suit.tooltip.summary: Combat: Sprays area water damage and washes beneficial potion effects off enemies. Work: The owner can right-click an adult cat with a wrench to ride underwater. Exhaustion triggers ascent; land riding is much slower.
item.laowu.cockroach_suit.tooltip.summar: Combat: Chase and leap at enemies with spread wings; nearby allied cockroach cats increase Health and Combat Power. Work: While idle, occasionally bonemeals farmland crops in a 9×9×9 area. Higher Health increases the chance.
item.laowu.music_suit.tooltip.behaviour1: Attack speed bonus is _5 + 0.2 × Speed_ %, or _5%/25% at 0/100 Speed_, without an extra cap. Radius _min(24, 5 + 0.03 × Intelligence)_ blocks. Smart cats favor high-DPS allies. Only the strongest bonus applies and lingers 2 seconds after leaving.
item.laowu.music_suit.tooltip.behaviour2: Skips non-records without consuming items. Removing the current record switches tracks; emptying the playlist or removing the suit stops playback.
item.laowu.music_suit.tooltip.behaviour3: _+10_ Speed, _+6_ maximum health, _+2_ armor and no added toughness. Support careers move _20% faster_ at the same Speed.
item.laowu.career_suit.support_movement: Support careers gain _+20%_ movement speed at equal Speed
item.laowu.medical_suit.tooltip.behaviou: Heals _1 + 0.03 × Intelligence_ HP/second: _4 HP/s at 100 Intelligence_. Starts after 1 second and heals every 0.25 seconds. Radius _min(32, 3 + 0.03 × Intelligence)_ blocks includes airborne cats. Higher Intelligence favors severely injured cats; only the strongest healer applies.
Cushion healing covers _3×3×3_, including itself, creatures and players, with clear sight. Uses the same healing rate and never stacks.
_+10_ Speed, _+6_ maximum health and _+2_ armor, with no added toughness. Support careers move _20% faster_ at the same Speed.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.moving_damage: Take %s less damage from living attackers while moving
item.laowu.engineering_suit.tooltip.summ: Combat: Deploy a cannon firing small cogs; its exclusive accessory unlocks large cogs and piercing shafts. Work: Seat the cat beneath a horizontal-facing Hand Crank directly above its cushion to turn it. More Stamina provides more stress capacity.
item.laowu.engineering_suit.tooltip.beha: _K × (2 + 0.08 × Combat Power)_ . At _80 Intelligence_, redeploys the cannon to control distance.
A horizontal-facing Create Hand Crank must be directly above the cushion. Each Stamina point supplies _128 SU_, with no extra cap.
_+10_ Luck, _+30_ maximum health, _+12_ armor and _+5_ toughness. No extra Combat Power or Intelligence.
item.laowu.medical_suit.tooltip.summary: Combat: Does not attack; approaches injured cats and channels in place to heal itself and nearby friendly career cats. Work: On a cushion, heals injured creatures and players in the surrounding 3×3×3.
item.laowu.music_suit.tooltip.summary: Combat: Does not attack; performs to increase nearby friendly career cats' attack speed. Work: Put records in its own nine inventory slots to loop them in slot order. No cushion required.
cat_accessory.laowu.label: [Cat Accessory]
cat_accessory.laowu.disabled: Disabled; removable without deleting the item.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.aggro_bias.po: More likely to draw nearby enemies' attention.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.aggro_bias.ne: Less likely to be targeted first; does not prevent retaliation.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.fire_immune: Immune to burning and lava damage.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.extra_strike_: %s chance for one extra single-target strike on hit; cannot chain.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.loot_magnet_r: Attract drops within %s blocks into the cat's inventory.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.pilot_dodge_p: Each Speed point grants %s dodge chance to negate one attack; capped at 80%%.
trait.laowu.pipa_performance.title: Pipa Serenade
trait.laowu.pipa_performance.summary: Plays a pipa while idle; Intelligence Attribute +10, Luck Attribute +10
trait.laowu.pipa_performance.description: While idle, holds the neck with one front paw and strums with a plectrum in the other, gently swaying. Pauses while moving, sleeping, hissing, riding or fighting. Intelligence Attribute +10, Luck Attribute +10.
trait.laowu.street_dance.title: Breakdance Cat
trait.laowu.street_dance.summary: Alternating hand support and flaring legs; Speed Attribute +10, Stamina Attribute +10
trait.laowu.street_dance.description: While stationary on the ground, including while sitting, alternates supporting front paws and lifts the free paw to clear its circling, spread hind legs. Pauses while moving, sleeping, hissing or fighting. Speed Attribute +10, Stamina Attribute +10.
gui.laowu.cat_filter.logic.empty_hint: Disabled conditions and empty groups are ignored
gui.laowu.cat_filter.logic.trait_hint: Empty = unrestricted; click a selected trait to remove
gui.laowu.cat_filter.logic.help.0: Match all or any enabled conditions across Current and Attribute Limits. Checkboxes enable conditions; editing a range enables it automatically.
gui.laowu.cat_filter.logic.help.1: Invert the entire attribute group. Example: all six limits 90–100, Match all, Invert on selects cats with at least one limit below 90. Empty groups are ignored.
gui.laowu.cat_filter.logic.help.2: Match all requires every selected trait. Match any requires at least one. All trait levels are accepted.
gui.laowu.cat_filter.logic.help.3: Invert the entire trait group. Select unwanted traits, Match any, Invert on to exclude cats with any unwanted trait.
gui.laowu.cat_filter.logic.help.4: Combine the attribute and trait groups using all or any. Identity is always required. Empty groups are ignored; non-cat items and cats without attribute data never pass.
tooltip.laowu.kimi_dye.crafting_body: Armour in centre; primary dye top-left, secondary dye top-middle.
tooltip.laowu.kimi_dye.crafting: Armour in the workbench centre; dyes above: primary, secondary, eyes. Empty slots keep their colour.
tooltip.laowu.kimi_dye.reset: Craft the armour alone to reset. Only the 16 dye colours; no colour mixing.
item.laowu.cat_storage_box.tooltip.summa: Right-click to store or release your pets, up to 9. Sneak-right-click a cat to collect your pets within 32 blocks, or the ground to release them all. Cats on seats are skipped.
message.laowu.cat_storage_box.unavailabl: No cats can be stored: cats on seats or being inspected are skipped.
message.laowu.cat_storage_box.not_owned: You can only collect your own pet cats.
message.laowu.cat_storage_box.busy: The cat is being inspected and cannot be stored yet.
message.laowu.cat_storage_box.empty: There are no cats in this box.
message.laowu.cat_storage_box.blocked: No safe release position, or this cat already exists. It remains in the box.
block.laowu.cat_carrier.tooltip.summary: Produces Hissing Gas while holding a cat pancake. Breaking it preserves the pancake and stored gas.
item.laowu.cat_carrier.tooltip.summary: Produces Hissing Gas while holding a cat pancake. Breaking it preserves the pancake and stored gas.
item.laowu.cat_laser_pointer.tooltip.sum: Right-click to command your cats to move or attack. Sneak-right-click opens the wheel for health bars, team display and combat mode.
gui.laowu.laser_wheel.title: Cat Commands
gui.laowu.laser_wheel.help: Click / 1–3 to toggle · Right-click / Esc to close
screen.laowu.world.cats_hiss.help: On by default. Disables ambient, trait and logistics hissing poses, paired audio and hiss production. Package transport and unrelated combat remain active.
screen.laowu.world.formula.attack: E=current Combat Power, M=Combat Power multiplier, K=suit damage coefficient. Attack damage=(2+0.08*E*M)*K, subject to the vanilla attack-attribute cap. Not used by unsuited cats.
screen.laowu.world.formula.health: E=current stat, M=multiplier. Max health=10+0.4*E*M+suit health. Other modifiers and game attribute caps still apply.
screen.laowu.world.formula.speed: E=current stat, M=multiplier. Movement=0.75+0.005*E*M. Career interval=round(career base interval-career speed coefficient*E*M), limited by career minimum.
screen.laowu.world.formula.stamina: E=current stat, M=multiplier. Armor=2+0.16*E*M+suit armor; toughness=0.05*E*M+suit toughness. Game attribute caps still apply.
screen.laowu.world.formula.intelligence: E=current stat, M=multiplier. Critical damage multiplier=1+0.01*E*M. Intelligence AI tiers do not scale.
screen.laowu.world.formula.luck: E=current stat, M=multiplier. Critical chance=min(100%,2%+0.18%*E*M). Fishing loot luck=min(5,3*E*M/100). Breeding luck is unchanged.
screen.laowu.world.formula_note: K is the current suit damage coefficient; attribute inputs also use their world multipliers. Shift previews include settings and the vanilla attack-attribute cap.
screen.laowu.world.title: World settings (Admin)
screen.laowu.world.denied: Only operators or the single-player world owner may change world settings.
screen.laowu.world.stale: Invalid or outdated settings. Refresh and try again.
screen.laowu.world.cat_death_attribute_p: On by default. Turn off to preserve base attributes when death creates a pancake.
screen.laowu.world.death_loss.help: Non-negative integer, default 20. Subtracted from one random base attribute, floored at zero. Zero disables the loss.
screen.laowu.world.death_outcome.help: Tamed cats: no pancake drops inventory and accessories normally. Other modes preserve owner and cargo in the pancake. Default: pancake item.
screen.laowu.world.death_help: Tamed cats only. No pancake drops cargo normally; the other modes use the penalty settings without changing potential. Respects mob loot. Totems and cockroach splitting retain their priority.
screen.laowu.world.suit_section_help: Switch combat/defense and six stat bonuses. Switching suits or sections preserves unsaved input.
screen.laowu.world.suit_support: Support careers never attack; damage and attack interval settings do not apply.
item.laowu.career_suit.configured_interv: Attack interval: _max(%s, round(%s - %s * Speed * stat multiplier)) ticks_. 20 ticks = 1 second; hurt cooldown and dive travel still apply.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.damage_coef: Replaces K in the suit damage formula. Range 0–999999; 0 removes base damage. Preview: attack damage.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.attack_inte: Ticks (20 = 1 second). Interval = max(minimum, round(base - reduction * Speed * stat multiplier)). Lower is faster; integer 1–999999. Preview: theoretical ticks; hurt cooldown and dive travel still apply.
Ticks removed per effective Speed point, including the world Speed multiplier. 0 disables speed-based reduction. Decimal 0–999999. Preview: attack interval.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.minimum_att: Interval floor, integer 1–999999 ticks; never more than once per tick. The floor wins even above the base interval. Does not bypass the target's hurt cooldown.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.health_bonu: Added directly to maximum health, not scaled by the Health stat multiplier. Range 0–999999; vanilla caps apply. Preview: maximum health.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.armor_bonus: Added directly to armor, not scaled by the Stamina multiplier. Range 0–999999; vanilla caps apply. Preview: armor.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.toughness_b: Added directly to armor toughness, not scaled by the Stamina multiplier. Range 0–999999; vanilla caps apply. Preview: toughness.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.attack_stat: Integer 0–999999 added to effective Combat Power before world multipliers and suit formulas. Does not change genes or training caps; effective stats remain capped at 999. Preview: attack damage.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.health_stat: Integer 0–999999 added to the Health stat before its multiplier/formula, unlike direct health points. Genes unchanged; effective stat cap 999. Preview: maximum health.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.speed_stat_: Integer 0–999999 added to Speed, affecting movement and attack interval. Genes unchanged; effective stat cap 999. Preview: movement multiplier.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.stamina_sta: Integer 0–999999 added to Stamina before armor/toughness formulas. Genes unchanged; effective stat cap 999. Preview: armor/toughness.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.intelligenc: Integer 0–999999 added to Intelligence, affecting its abilities and AI thresholds. Genes unchanged; effective stat cap 999. Preview: critical damage multiplier.
screen.laowu.world.suit_help.luck_stat_b: Integer 0–999999 added to Luck for critical hits, fishing and other Luck checks. Genes unchanged; effective stat cap 999. Preview: critical chance.
screen.laowu.world.career_reset_help: Reset all editable parameters for the selected suit across both sections. Global locks and other suits are unchanged. Click Save to apply.
screen.laowu.world.career_help: Edit K directly in (2+0.08*Combat Power*stat multiplier)*K, with no extra multiplier. Range 0–999999; defaults differ by suit. Examples use active attribute multipliers and this draft coefficient.
screen.laowu.world.career_note: Edit K in the formula; support careers still never attack
item.laowu.career_suit.configured_damage: Suit damage coefficient K: %s (used below and in Shift previews)
screen.laowu.world.global_notice: [Global] settings are locked; other settings remain per-world
screen.laowu.world.global_locked: Forced by the server/host config/%s. Cannot be edited in-game. Set the global entry back to -1 to restore this world's saved value.
screen.laowu.world.read_only: Read only · Awaiting server / Admin permission required
screen.laowu.world.multiplier_help: 0–999999; default 1. Scales attribute inputs to ability formulas, not displayed genes, training caps or inheritance. 0 retains fixed formula terms and suit bonuses. Select a value to preview examples.
screen.laowu.world.show_hell_recipes: Show hidden legacy recipes in JEI: %s
screen.laowu.world.show_hell_recipes.hel: Show legacy liquid-cat mixing, cat powder milling/crushing and cat strip cutting. Visibility only; crafting and pancake variant deduplication are unchanged.
screen.laowu.world.wild_cats_flee.help: Off by default. Vanilla cats do not avoid creative/spectator players; test in Survival. Controls vanilla player avoidance and panic from damage/fire, not special traits, combat positioning or pet following.
screen.laowu.world.example.attack: Combat Power → Career damage input (suit multiplier applies)
screen.laowu.world.example.health: Health → Base maximum health (before suit bonuses)
screen.laowu.world.example.speed: Speed → Movement multiplier (career cooldowns also scale)
screen.laowu.world.example.stamina: Stamina → Base armor / toughness (before suit bonuses)
screen.laowu.world.example.intelligence: Intelligence → Critical damage multiplier (AI tiers unchanged)
screen.laowu.world.example.luck: Luck → Critical chance (fishing loot luck also scales)
screen.laowu.nearby_cat_spawning.descrip: Personal preference: extra block-material cats near you every 10-15 minutes. Synced to the server; vanilla spawns and other players are unaffected.
tooltip.laowu.attribute_debug_wand: Use on a cat, living cat pancake, or dropped cat-pancake item to edit base attributes and training limits.
tooltip.laowu.trait_debug_wand: Use on a cat, living cat pancake, or dropped cat-pancake item to add, remove, and level traits.
item.laowu.cat_filter.summary.default: Allows every cat pancake carrying attribute data
item.laowu.cat_filter.summary.name: Cat name: %s
gui.laowu.cat_filter.name: Name
gui.laowu.cat_filter.name.hint: Blank means any; exact name match
gui.laowu.cat_filter.trait.selector: Scroll to select a required trait
gui.laowu.cat_filter.trait.match_all_lev: Trait level is ignored when filtering
gui.laowu.cat_filter.trait.remove_hint: Click a selected trait to remove it
item.laowu.cat_scanner.tooltip.summary: Activates while aimed at a _cat_; use it to open the _Cat Profile_.
screen.laowu.hissing_volume.description: Only affects the special audio triggered by two or more hissing cats
screen.laowu.cat_trait_editor.shift_hint: Use −/+ to adjust; hold Shift to remove or set the maximum level
tooltip.laowu.fusion_wand.usage: Use on two cats, then use on the ground to simulate Normal Breeding Food
tooltip.laowu.fusion_wand.mutation: Uses the Advanced Box's 30% base mutation rate plus parent Luck; sneak-use a cat to clear selections
message.laowu.fusion_wand.second: Selected second cat: %s; use the wand on the ground to simulate breeding
message.laowu.fusion_wand.same_parent: The two parents cannot be the same cat
message.laowu.fusion_wand.parents_unavai: A parent is in another dimension, unloaded, or no longer present
message.laowu.fusion_wand.spawned: Simulated breeding and created an adult offspring
gui.laowu.cat_stats.hold_shift: Hold Shift to view Attribute Limits
gui.laowu.cat_stats.release_shift: Release Shift to view Current Attributes
screen.laowu.cat_attribute_editor.shift_: Hold Shift while clicking to adjust by 10
ingredient.laowu.named_player_name_tag: Name Tag with a Player Name
item.laowu.pheromone_cat_food.tooltip.su: Feed this to an unowned kitten or adult cat to tame it for the bound owner; kittens also grow up immediately. It can also be deployed onto a Cat Pancake. Mix ordinary Cat Food with a Name Tag renamed to a player.
item.laowu.pheromone_cat_food.message.al: This cat already has an owner
item.laowu.pheromone_cat_food.message.un: This Pheromone Cat Food has no bound owner
No player named %s could be found
item.laowu.breeding_cat_food.tooltip.sum: Inherits 5 random parental attributes and rerolls the remaining 1.
item.laowu.mutation_cat_food.tooltip.sum: Inherits 5 random parental attributes and rerolls the remaining one; Mutation Chance +40%, with a higher chance of new Good and Excellent traits.
item.laowu.attack_breeding_cat_food.tool: Always inherits the better parental Combat Power Attribute plus 4 random attributes. If both corresponding Limits are at least 90, the child's value and Limit gain +1.
item.laowu.health_breeding_cat_food.tool: Always inherits the better parental Health Attribute plus 4 random attributes. If both corresponding Limits are at least 90, the child's value and Limit gain +1.
item.laowu.speed_breeding_cat_food.toolt: Always inherits the better parental Speed Attribute plus 4 random attributes. If both corresponding Limits are at least 90, the child's value and Limit gain +1.
item.laowu.stamina_breeding_cat_food.too: Always inherits the better parental Stamina Attribute plus 4 random attributes. If both corresponding Limits are at least 90, the child's value and Limit gain +1.
item.laowu.intelligence_breeding_cat_foo: Always inherits the better parental Intelligence Attribute plus 4 random attributes. If both corresponding Limits are at least 90, the child's value and Limit gain +1.
item.laowu.luck_breeding_cat_food.toolti: Always inherits the better parental Luck Attribute plus 4 random attributes. If both corresponding Limits are at least 90, the child's value and Limit gain +1.
block.laowu.basic_breeding_box.tooltip.s: Insert two adult Cat Pancakes and breeding food to produce a kitten pancake after 2 minutes. Base mutation chance: 10%; no automation. Hold Shift in the breeding screen to view both parents' Attribute Limits.
block.laowu.intermediate_breeding_box.to: Insert two adult Cat Pancakes and breeding food to produce a kitten pancake after 1 minute 30 seconds. Base mutation chance: 15%; supports hopper input and output. Hold Shift in the breeding screen to view both parents' Attribute Limits.
block.laowu.advanced_breeding_box.toolti: Produces a kitten pancake after 1 minute with a 20% base mutation chance. Its top control selects Locked, replacement after every breeding cycle, or redstone-pulse replacement. Adjacent side containers supply parents ranked by Attribute Limits; Cat Filters can set targets, while an empty slot targets 100 in all six Limits. Hold Shift in the breeding screen to view Attribute Limits.
block.laowu.adoption_box.tooltip.summary: Cat pancakes are adopted for random villager trade goods. Villagers seated against the four sides determine the professions rewarded.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.mutation.title: Mutation Chance
gui.laowu.breeding_box.mutation.source: Source: the box's base chance plus Mutation Cat Food (40%), then increased by the parents' average Luck Attribute.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.mutation.attribut: Each uninherited attribute rolls separately; a success rerolls it once and keeps the result with the higher Limit.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.mutation.other: Each appearance region rolls separately; a successful trait roll adds one compatible new trait if a slot is available. Mutation Cat Food favors Good and Excellent new traits.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.title: Using the Breeding Box
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.insert: Use to insert: cat pancakes fill Father then Mother; breeding food enters the food slot.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.extract: Sneak-use to retrieve: kitten, food, mother, then father.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.start: With both parents, breeding food, and an empty child slot, breeding starts; completion consumes 1 food and creates a kitten pancake.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.shift: The screen shows Current Attributes by default; hold Shift to view Attribute Limits in dark-blue digits.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.attributes: Attributes: Current and Limit are always inherited together. Food selects the count; other attributes reroll. Stat food locks its named attribute; if both parental Limits are at least 90, the child's Current and Limit gain +1.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.traits: Traits: shared traits are guaranteed and each one-parent trait has a 50% chance. Offspring traits start at level I; Doughy is never inherited. Mutation may add one new trait.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.appearance: Appearance: every region independently inherits one parent's material and may mutate.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.level.title: Breeding Box Tier
gui.laowu.breeding_box.level.effect: Tier determines the box's base mutation chance and breeding duration.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.level.advanced_re: The Advanced Box's top control selects Locked, Automatic Replacement, or Redstone Activated. Replacement ranks Attribute Limits only; side Cat Filters can set targets, while an empty slot targets 100 in all six Limits.
item.laowu.terminator_suit.tooltip.summa: Combat: Ranged laser attacks with steady damage. Work: No dedicated work ability.
item.laowu.terminator_suit.tooltip.behav: Combat Power Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+20_; Armor _+6_; Armor Toughness _+3_.
item.laowu.fishing_suit.tooltip.summary: Combat: Casts a fishing hook at enemies. Work: Sit on a cushion beside a container, with water beside the block beneath the cushion, to fish. Larger connected water is faster; Luck improves loot.
item.laowu.fishing_suit.tooltip.behaviou: The cushion must touch an item container, and water must adjoin the block beneath it. Catches enter the container; overflow drops nearby. Connected water size improves fishing speed, and Luck improves loot.
Luck Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+20_; Armor _+5_; Armor Toughness _+2_.
item.laowu.flight_suit.tooltip.summary: Combat: Circles and dives into enemies. Work: The owner can right-click an adult cat with a Create wrench to hang below it and fly. Stamina extends flight and Speed increases pace; exhaustion starts gliding.
item.laowu.flight_suit.tooltip.behaviour: Space to ascend, Ctrl to descend, sneak to detach. Flight duration: _max(5, 5 + 0.25 × Stamina)_ seconds. Speed: _0.2 + 0.003 × Speed_ blocks/tick.
Combat Power Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+30_; Armor _+7_; Armor Toughness _+3_.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.summary: Combat: Breathes area flames and ignites enemies. Work: Sit on a cushion horizontally adjacent to a Blaze Burner to keep it burning without fuel.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.behaviour1: _K × (2 + 0.08 × Combat Power)_ . Hits ignite for _3 seconds_.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.behaviour2: Only horizontally adjacent burners are heated. The Superheat Gene can provide superheating.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.behaviour3: Stamina Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+40_; Armor _+10_; Armor Toughness _+4_.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.summary: Combat: Fires honey missiles that slow enemies. Work: Place a cushion on a bee nest or beehive and seat the cat to increase its honey level.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.behaviour1: _K × (2 + 0.08 × Combat Power)_ . Hits apply _Slowness II for 3 seconds_.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.behaviour2: Adds _1 honey level every 10 seconds_ by default, pausing when full. Relevant traits can shorten the interval.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.behaviour3: Speed Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+24_; Armor _+5_; Armor Toughness _+2_.
item.laowu.transport_suit.tooltip.summar: Combat: Does not attack; supplies friendly career cats with combat buffs. Work: Two seated logistics cats sharing an address exchange places to transport packages. Packagers beneath their cushions allow automatic loading/unloading.
item.laowu.transport_suit.tooltip.behavi: Supplies a cat in combat every _1 second_, with _5 seconds_ between deliveries to the same recipient. Adds one missing Strength, Speed, Resistance, Regeneration or Fire Resistance effect for _20 seconds_.

Exactly two logistics cats in the same dimension must share a nonempty address and be seated on different cushions. Packages can be loaded manually; powered packagers beneath cushions load, and unpowered packagers unload.
Speed Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+30_; Armor _+10_; Armor Toughness _+3_; support moves _20%_ faster at the same Speed.
item.laowu.dynamite_suit.tooltip.summary: Combat: Throws area-damage dynamite; rushes an enemy and self-destructs when mortally wounded. Work: No dedicated work ability.
item.laowu.dynamite_suit.tooltip.behavio: _K × (2 + 0.08 × Combat Power)_ . The fatal-hit self-destruct deals _5×_ ordinary attack damage.
Combat Power Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+24_; Armor _+5_; Armor Toughness _+2_.
item.laowu.career_suit.hold_ctrl: Hold _Ctrl_ for ability details and formulas
item.laowu.cat_fur.tooltip: Use _Shears_ by hand or with a _Deployer_ on a cat
Has every function of the _Engineer's Goggles_ and reveals the attribute panel of cats in any state and anywhere!
item.laowu.cat_sword.tooltip.summary: Can enter an _empowered state_; every third attack arms _Empowered Melee I_.
item.laowu.cat_sword.tooltip.behaviour1: Toggles _empowerment_; empowered actions consume _three times_ the Hiss.
item.laowu.cat_pickaxe.tooltip.summary: When empowered, automatically _smelts_ drops from mined blocks.
item.laowu.cat_pickaxe.tooltip.behaviour: Toggles _empowerment_; empowered actions consume _three times_ the Hiss.
item.laowu.cat_axe.tooltip.summary: When empowered, wood blocks drop their corresponding _stripped_ forms.
item.laowu.cat_axe.tooltip.behaviour1: Toggles _empowerment_; empowered actions consume _three times_ the Hiss.
item.laowu.cat_shovel.tooltip.summary: When empowered, digs dirt, sand and other shovel blocks _extremely quickly_.
item.laowu.cat_shovel.tooltip.behaviour1: Toggles _empowerment_; empowered actions consume _three times_ the Hiss.
item.laowu.cat_hoe.tooltip.summary: When empowered, tills a _3×3_ area and automatically _waters_ the farmland.
item.laowu.cat_hoe.tooltip.behaviour1: Toggles _empowerment_; the clicked block is _bottom-centre_, and Hiss use is _tripled_.
item.laowu.cat_can.tooltip.summary: Used only for cat breeding and crafting attribute cans; it does not raise attributes.
item.laowu.golden_cat_can.tooltip.summar: Used only for cat breeding and crafting attribute cans; it does not raise attributes.
item.laowu.attack_cat_can.tooltip.summar: For _cats or Cat Pancakes_: Combat Power Attribute _+1_, up to its Attribute Limit.
item.laowu.health_cat_can.tooltip.summar: For _cats or Cat Pancakes_: Health Attribute _+1_, up to its Attribute Limit.

item.laowu.agent_suit.tooltip.behaviour1: _K × (2 + 0.08 × Combat Power)_ . Rear attacks always critically hit, with Intelligence-based critical damage. At _60 Intelligence_, flanks enemies. Smoke concealment has no Intelligence requirement: when targeted with nearby non-support friendly cats, immediately releases smoke and retreats; smoke cooldown is _10 seconds_.
item.laowu.agent_suit.tooltip.behaviour2: Must sit on a Create seat. Watch radius is _min(128, 0.64 × Intelligence)_ blocks: 32 at 50, 64 at 100, and 128 at 200 or more, including vertical distance. Refreshes each second and reveals loaded hostiles through obstacles. Leaving range, unseating, or removing the suit clears the mark. Multiple agents can cover overlapping areas.
item.laowu.diving_suit.tooltip.behaviour: _K × (2 + 0.08 × Combat Power)_ . Water removes beneficial potion effects only; negative effects remain.

Steer with WASD and your view; Space ascends, Ctrl descends, Shift dismounts. Underwater speed is _130%_ of an equal-stat pilot, reduced by _80%_ on land. Air lasts _5 + 0.25 × Stamina_ seconds, at least 5 seconds. On exhaustion, slow down and surface; recover on land.
item.laowu.cockroach_suit.tooltip.behavi: _K × (2 + 0.08 × Combat Power)_ . Each other friendly cockroach within 12 blocks grants _+6_ Health and Combat Power, not Stamina; the existing effective-stat cap of 999 applies.
Every _5 seconds_ without a combat target, rolls _min(100%, Health × 0.5%)_. Success bonemeals one random eligible crop on farmland within 9×9×9. No cushion or bone meal item required.
item.laowu.terminator_suit.tooltip.comba: Ranged laser attacks with steady damage.
item.laowu.fishing_suit.tooltip.combat: Casts a fishing hook at enemies.
item.laowu.fishing_suit.tooltip.work: Sit on a cushion beside a container, with water beside the block beneath the cushion, to fish. Larger connected water is faster; Luck improves loot.
item.laowu.flight_suit.tooltip.work: The owner can right-click an adult cat with a Create wrench to hang below it and fly. Stamina extends flight and Speed increases pace; exhaustion starts gliding.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.combat: Breathes area flames and ignites enemies.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.work: Sit on a cushion horizontally adjacent to a Blaze Burner to keep it burning without fuel.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.combat: Fires honey missiles that slow enemies.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.work: Place a cushion on a bee nest or beehive and seat the cat to increase its honey level.
item.laowu.transport_suit.tooltip.combat: Does not attack; supplies friendly career cats with combat buffs.
item.laowu.transport_suit.tooltip.work: Two seated logistics cats sharing an address exchange places to transport packages. Packagers beneath their cushions allow automatic loading/unloading.
item.laowu.dynamite_suit.tooltip.combat: Throws area-damage dynamite; rushes an enemy and self-destructs when mortally wounded.
item.laowu.engineering_suit.tooltip.comb: Deploy a cannon firing small cogs; its exclusive accessory unlocks large cogs and piercing shafts.
item.laowu.engineering_suit.tooltip.work: Seat the cat beneath a horizontal-facing Hand Crank directly above its cushion to turn it. More Stamina provides more stress capacity.
item.laowu.medical_suit.tooltip.combat: Does not attack; approaches injured cats and channels in place to heal itself and nearby friendly career cats.
item.laowu.medical_suit.tooltip.work: On a cushion, heals injured creatures and players in the surrounding 3×3×3.
item.laowu.music_suit.tooltip.combat: Does not attack; performs to increase nearby friendly career cats' attack speed.
item.laowu.music_suit.tooltip.work: Put records in its own nine inventory slots to loop them in slot order. No cushion required.
item.laowu.agent_suit.tooltip.combat: High-damage melee with guaranteed rear criticals. Smart cats flank. When targeted with nearby non-support friendly cats, retreats under smoke.
item.laowu.agent_suit.tooltip.work: While seated on a cushion, reveals hostile creatures with red outlines. Intelligence increases the watch radius, up to 128 blocks.
item.laowu.diving_suit.tooltip.combat: Sprays area water damage and washes beneficial potion effects off enemies.
item.laowu.diving_suit.tooltip.work: The owner can right-click an adult cat with a wrench to ride underwater. Exhaustion triggers ascent; land riding is much slower.
item.laowu.cockroach_suit.tooltip.combat: Chase and leap at enemies with spread wings; nearby allied cockroach cats increase Health and Combat Power.
item.laowu.cockroach_suit.tooltip.work: While idle, occasionally bonemeals farmland crops in a 9×9×9 area. Higher Health increases the chance.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.fishing_pull: Fishing-hook hits pull enemies toward the cat.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.super_flame_m: Breathe blue superheated flame; fire-breath damage ×%s.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.honey_patch: Hits leave a honey patch beneath the enemy for 5s, slowing creatures that touch it.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.enhanced_poti: Delivered logistics potions become level II and can upgrade existing level-I effects.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.engineering_s: Each shot has a 20%% large-cog and 20%% shaft chance. Large cogs burst for the same area damage; shafts pierce creatures with +20%% damage. Other shots are small cogs.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.medical_guard: Patients currently being treated take %s less damage; matching protection does not stack.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.music_speed_b: Music-boosted cats gain +%s Speed; matching bonuses do not stack.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.music_movemen: Music-boosted cats gain %s movement speed; matching bonuses do not stack.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.healing_smoke: Cover smoke turns green and heals the agent and allied cats within 3 blocks for 2.5 HP/s for five seconds; does not stack with other healing.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.diving_cleans: Attack spray also removes harmful potion effects from allied cats inside its cone, without friendly damage.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.cockroach_spl: On death, split into two cockroach kittens, each inheriting 50%% of the raw attributes;
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.damage_combo: Consecutive hits: +%s%% damage per stack (max 5). One stack per 0.5s; clears on target change or 4s without a hit.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.opening_damag: Deal +%s%% damage to enemies above 90%% health.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.critical_hast: After a critical hit: +%s%% attack speed for 4s; 8s cooldown, cannot refresh.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.melee_reflect: Reflect %s%% of actual melee damage taken.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.emergency_shi: Surviving a drop to 35%% health or below grants a shield worth %s%% maximum health for 6s; 15s cooldown, costs 1 durability per trigger; incompatible with Golden Kimi.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.heavy_hit_cap: Cap a single hit exceeding %1$s%% maximum health at %1$s%%; 15s cooldown, costs 1 durability per trigger; incompatible with Cork Vest.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.rest_heal: After 10s out of combat, recover %s health every 2s; stops immediately in combat.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.healing_recei: Receive +%s%% healing, including medical cats and healing smoke.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.owner_attack_: Gain +%s Attack stat while the owner is within 4 blocks.
cat_accessory.laowu.effect.sample_pickup: Automatically collect only item types already in the 9-slot cargo; works with the magnet.
block.laowu.wish_adoption_box.tooltip.su: Place a pancake meeting the NOW base stats or MAX stat limits on the left to receive the specified accessory immediately. Lock the trade to keep its conditions and reward.
gui.laowu.wish_adoption.lock_hint: Lock or unlock this offer. Locked trades keep their conditions and reward. Unlocking only affects future trades.
gui.laowu.wish_adoption.now_hint: NOW: current base stats, excluding traits, suits, accessories and temporary bonuses
gui.laowu.wish_adoption.max_hint: MAX: the cat pancake's attribute ceilings
gui.laowu.wish_adoption.input_hint: Meet ALL conditions. The cat pancake and its carried items are consumed.
message.laowu.cat_pouch.busy: This cat is being viewed or used and cannot be stored yet
item.laowu.cat_filter.wish_import: Right-click a Wish Adoption Box to reset and copy its current NOW/MAX ranges
message.laowu.cat_filter.wish_imported: Filter reset: imported %s with %s adoption requirements
message.laowu.cat_filter.no_offer: No adoption offer is available to copy
